setup_task: (Setup) Create sample text with multiple words and paragraphs
setup_steps: Type "Alpha Beta Gamma" and press Enter.
Type "Delta Epsilon Zeta" and press Enter.
main_task: Show formatting marks in the document

setup_task: (Setup) Create text with two separate paragraphs
setup_steps: Type "This paragraph is for testing language settings."
Type "https://example.com should not be spell checked."
main_task: Set the second paragraph to None (Do not check spelling) using Tools > Language
main_steps: Click anywhere in the second paragraph.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a tracked change that can be rejected
setup_steps: Click at the end of the text and type " updated".
main_task: Reject the tracked change from the context menu

setup_task: (Setup) Create a numbered list with a nested subpoint
setup_steps: Click the Toggle Ordered List button on the toolbar.
Click View > Toolbars > Bullets and Numbering.
Click in the second numbered item "Check email".
Click the Demote One Level button on the Bullets and Numbering toolbar.
main_task: Move the nested item back to the top level using the keyboard shortcut
main_steps: Click at the beginning of the text in the second list item, after its number.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a document with enough pages to show page numbering
setup_steps: Type "First paragraph" in the blank document.
main_task: Start the first page number at 3
main_steps: Click in the first paragraph on the first page.
Click in the first paragraph in the text area.
In the Breaks section, check Insert.
Leave the first page's current page style selected.
Type 3 in the Page number field.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a multi-page Writer document for brochure printing preview
setup_steps: Open the Insert menu and click Page Break.
Open the Insert menu and click Page Break.
Open the Insert menu and click Page Break.
main_task: Set the document to brochure printing and show only even pages in the Print dialog
main_steps: Open the File menu and click Print.
If the Print dialog shows a General tab, open it.
In the Page Layout section, click more.
In the Range and Copies section, open the Include or Pages to Print drop-down list.

main_task: Insert a signature line with the signer details shown in the example dialog
main_steps: In the Name field, type "John Doe".
Leave the checkboxes "Signer can add comments" and "Show sign date in signature line" checked.

main_task: Create a new Gallery theme named "Project Logos"
main_steps: Show the Gallery in the Sidebar.
Click the New button below the list of themes.
In the Properties of New Theme dialog, click the General tab.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a small table to prepare for inserting columns
main_task: Insert 2 columns after the selected column
main_steps: Click in the second column of the table.
In the dialog, set Number to 2.

setup_task: Create a table for deleting a column
setup_steps: Click in the blank Writer document.
Open the Table menu and choose Insert Table.
Set the table to 3 columns and 3 rows.
main_task: Delete the middle column of the table using the context menu
main_steps: Select all cells in the second column.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a document with headings, insert a table of contents, and then add another heading
setup_steps: Type “Main Title” on the first line.
Open the paragraph style list and choose “Heading 1”.
Open the paragraph style list and choose “Heading 1”.
Open the paragraph style list and choose “Heading 1”.
Choose Table of Contents and Index.
Choose Table of Contents, Index or Bibliography.
Click after the table of contents.
Open the paragraph style list and choose “Heading 1”.
main_task: Update the table of contents so the new heading appears in it
main_steps: Right-click anywhere inside the table of contents.

setup_task: (Setup) Insert a bibliography so the bibliography paragraph style can be modified
setup_steps: Point to Table of Contents and Index.
Click Table of Contents, Index or Bibliography.
In the dialog, set Type to Bibliography.
main_task: Create a list style named Bibliography with square brackets and 1.00 cm indentation, then apply it to the Bibliography 1 paragraph style
main_steps: Open the Styles deck in the sidebar.
In the Organizer tab, type Bibliography in the name field.
Delete any other punctuation from the After box.
Type 1.00 cm in the Tab stop at box.
Type 1.00 cm in the Indent at box.
In the Styles deck, click the Paragraph Styles icon.
Choose All Styles from the list at the bottom of the Styles deck.
In the Paragraph Style dialog, click the Outline & List tab.

setup_task: (Setup) Create a paragraph that can be turned into a hidden paragraph
setup_steps: Type "This paragraph is hidden when the condition is true."
main_task: Apply a hidden paragraph condition to the paragraph
main_steps: Select "Hidden Paragraph" in the Type list.

main_task: Change the default text document save format to Word 2007–365 and set the ODF version to 1.2 Extended
main_steps: In the left pane, click the expansion control next to Load/Save.
In Default File Format and ODF Settings, open the ODF format version list.
Verify Document type is Text document.
Open the Always save as list.

main_task: Add the “About LibreOffice” command to the File menu in Writer
main_steps: In the Customize dialog, click the Menus tab.
Open the Scope drop-down and select LibreOffice Writer.
Open the Target drop-down and select File.
In the Available Commands list, click About LibreOffice.
Click the large right arrow to add it to the File menu.
